data.description:
## Description

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-verifier-output.sh` — a bash validator that checks verifier ruling output conforms to the fingerprint schema defined in T2's agent file. Called from S4 dispatch wiring.

## Done Definitions

- `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-verifier-output.sh` exists and is executable
- Validates fingerprint format `<path>:<line-start>-<line-end>`:
  - Accepts: `path/file.py:42-42` (single line), `path/file.py:10-15` (range), `path/file.py:0-0` (sentinel)
  - Rejects: `path/file.py:42` (no range), `path/file.py:a-b` (non-integer), `path/file.py:50-10` (start > end for non-sentinel)
- Enforces `line-start == line-end` for single-line findings (documented in schema as "constraint")
- Emits clear error message on rejection: `"Invalid fingerprint format: <value> — expected <path>:<line-start>-<line-end>"`
- Running `tests/agents/test-validate-verifier-output.sh` exits 0 after this task

## File Impact

- `plugins/dso/scripts/validate-verifier-output.sh` — NEW, executable

## Testing Mode

GREEN — makes T1 validator tests pass

## Dependencies

Must be created after T2 (agent file defines the schema this validator enforces)
